jordan: @deploy-bot starting rollout to eu-west1 canary — v2.18.0. 10% traffic for 30m. Need statuspage snippet & customer comm for the change window (2026-03-22 00:00-02:00 UTC).

deploy-bot: Deploy started: DPL-2026-03-21-91 -> eu-west1 (canary). traffic=10% window=30m. id=DPL-2026-03-21-91

nina: Suggest we pin Dedicated customers on 2.17.9 for the maintenance window to avoid config drift. @lia-support can you prepare the public status copy + email + SMS blurb?

lia-support: Yup, draft below — quick review please.

```statuspage
Summary: Planned maintenance: inference runtime update (v2.18.0)
Start: 2026-03-22 00:00 UTC
End: 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC
Impact: No expected downtime for hosted API. Dedicated customers may see brief failover to pinned versions if they are on auto-roll.
Details: We're rolling out a batching optimization and a minor kernel change that reduces cost per token. We'll monitor latency and error rates closely; canary will run in eu-west1 first.
``` 

```email
Subject: Notice: Scheduled maintenance — inference runtime update (Mar 22)
Hi <Customer>,
We're scheduled to roll out an update to the Redwood inference runtime on 2026-03-22 00:00-02:00 UTC. This change improves batching and token efficiency.
Hosted API: no action required. Dedicated/Private: if you'd like to remain on the current runtime during the window, reply to this email and we'll pin you to v2.17.9 temporarily.
If we detect regressions we'll roll back and notify via status.redwood.ai.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops
``` 

sam-sre: Proposed rollback script if errors exceed 5% or p99 > 300ms for > 5m:

```bash
# rollback to previous stable
redwoodctl deploy rollback --release DPL-2026-03-21-91 --region eu-west1
redwoodctl routing set-weight --service inference --region eu-west1 --weight 0.0
``` 

jordan: Ack. Rollback criteria set. @sam-sre you own rollback exec, @nina you handle customer pin coordination with support.

nina: On it. I'll open the pin-request thread and start sending the pinned-version opt-in emails for Dedicated customers in scope.
